long_biography.plain_text:
Alexandre Nicaise co-founded Alphalink in Paris in 1999, when it was a small team managing virtual private networks for large companies. As the internet market changed, the business moved into telecommunications, created Init Sys for virtual operators and developed white-label services through Dimension Telecom. Nicaise remained president as the group relocated to western France and broadened its partner network.

Under his leadership, Alphalink added voice-over-IP, mobile connectivity and a Courbevoie data centre before building its own business-fibre network. It later expanded through acquisitions and developed digital platforms that let resellers and IT integrators manage converged services. The current offer spans fixed and mobile communications, hosting, collaboration and cybersecurity, while retaining an indirect model built around independent technology partners.
